Banks Fined for Service Issues Affecting Senior Citizens

Two separate incidents highlight banking service failures impacting elderly customers. In one case, a bank was ordered to pay compensation for failing to activate a senior citizen's debit card for over a year. In another, a bank was fined for freezing a senior citizen's funds.
